summary: Whether you show it or not, deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you read people and care on instinct, you imagine, feel for others, and create. It rewards you when you reach for it.
body: Whether you show it or not, deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you read people and care on instinct, you imagine, feel for others, and create. It rewards you when you reach for it. Strong for imaginative work; protect boundaries and energy. Sensitivity may be a source of comfort here. Emotional safety can grow through imagination, compassion, and the feeling of being gently understood.
gift: At your best: you read people and care on instinct, and you imagine, feel for others, and create.
shadow: The trap: your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need - or you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline.
integration: Let emotional needs and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Strong for imaginative work; protect boundaries and energy.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you read people and you imagine, feel for others, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
